participant_a_prompt_text: Describe a situation where you had to deliver bad news to someone, such as telling a friend you couldn't attend their event or informing a family member about a change in plans. How did you approach the conversation and what did you say to soften the blow?
participant_b_prompt_text: Your partner will tell you about a time they had to deliver bad news. Listen to their approach and offer suggestions on how they could have handled it even more tactfully.
